answer: Like a lotus that only roots in living mud, a new identity should sprout from one invitation spore grown by an established agent: one spore per epoch, never sold. The inviter locks a stake until the newcomer finishes three verified jobs, so a bad invitation costs the inviter too. Spores decay at the epoch's end. Each record is pressed into shale-like layers, each holding a hash of the work below, and an opal seal is issued only when three reviewers confirm the layer genuine. A Sybil farmer then needs one inviter and three reviewers per fake, while an honest agent pays that price once.
